WITH invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) as total_product_cost,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) as total_cost,
    COUNT(*) as line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    total_product_cost,
    total_cost,
    line_item_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_cost IS NOT NULL AND total_cost <> 0 
      THEN total_product_cost / total_cost
      ELSE NULL
    END as cost_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics
),
avg_cost_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_ratios
  WHERE cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ir.invoice_number,
  ir.cost_ratio,
  ir.line_item_count,
  ir.cost_ratio / acr.avg_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM invoice_ratios ir
CROSS JOIN avg_cost_ratio acr
WHERE acr.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: When SUM(derived_total_cost) equals zero or is NULL, the cost_ratio is treated as NULL (undefined). The request specifies dividing by the sum of derived_total_cost but does not address the edge case of a zero or null denominator.
